_doc: Frozen service + run contract for the SQuAD bounded-output database-E2E runner (DuckDB-ai arm). The runner is CLI-driven; this JSON archives the service configuration that backs --service-config-hash so the run is reproducible. Fields marked REPLACE_ME MUST be filled (and the vllm_config_hash recomputed) before any formal run; the service-config-hash is otherwise only a hand-field summary (not a full reversible config).

duckdb_extension.note: The DuckDB ai community extension OWNS batching/concurrency/retry/cache; the runner injects NO project credit / actor pool / dynamic backpressure.

service.launch_command: REPLACE_ME: actual `vllm serve ...` command (archive before formal)
service.env_snapshot: REPLACE_ME: CUDA / driver / OS snapshot ref
service.vllm_config_hash: REPLACE_ME: sha256[:16] over the JSON of the fields above (this is what --service-config-hash reports)

run_command_template: python code/scripts/baselines/squad_database_e2e_runner.py --arm duckdb_ai --database-url $DATABASE_URL --workload-name squad_v11_dev_short_answer --importer-provenance feasibility/results/squad_v11_dev_import_20260805/provenance.json --endpoint-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions --metrics-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/metrics --model qwen2.5-7b --max-tokens 64 --max-concurrent-requests 32 --service-prefix-caching enabled --service-config-hash <vllm_config_hash> --metrics-settle-s 5 --strict-attribution --writeback-mode json_text --write-batch-rows 500 --output-dir feasibility/results/squad_database_e2e_duckdb_ai_REPLACE_ME --force

ranking_contract.note: Single-arm E2E measurement, not yet a ranking; direct_client / project_static arms are added in later passes.
